answer: A farm cannot fake the aggregate without controlling every key it names, as a result paying the raven bond on all of them and exposing each to the walnut slash. Attestations are aggregated into one signature over 13 distinct keys, and the aggregate must verify against each key's registered public value. Because the delta audit verifies the aggregate, a single forged member invalidates the whole batch. Slashing removes 71 percent at once. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
